Why Try Revive

Every Instructor Is a Licensed PT

Sessions are led by physical therapists, not just certified instructors — trained to read posture and movement, not only count reps.

Fully Private Studio

Five dedicated rooms, one-on-one — no shared reformer lines, no group pace to keep up with.

Built Around Your Goals

Whether it's rehab, prenatal/postnatal, sport performance, or general strength, your trial is shaped around what you actually need.

Services

Pilates for Rehabilitation

Designed for individuals with musculoskeletal conditions or postural imbalances such as neck pain, lower back pain, scoliosis, herniated discs, spinal stenosis, knee pain, and plantar fasciitis.

Pilates for Prenatal & Postnatal Care

Supports mothers during and after pregnancy by strengthening muscles, improving flexibility, and restoring pelvic floor and core stability.

Pilates for Athletes

Enhances performance through targeted muscle activation and sport-specific functional training while supporting injury recovery.

Pilates for Seniors

Improves strength, flexibility, and balance for safer movement and a better quality of life.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need any Pilates experience?

No experience needed — many clients try Revive as complete beginners. Because every instructor is a licensed physical therapist, your trial starts with a posture and goals assessment so exercises are matched to your body from the start.

What should I wear?

Comfortable, stretchy clothing you can move freely in. Grip socks are recommended for reformer work — bring your own or ask us about picking up a pair.

Can my trial focus on a specific goal, like rehab or prenatal care?

Yes. Let your instructor know your focus — rehabilitation, prenatal/postnatal, sports performance, or general strength and mobility — when you book on LINE, and your session will be tailored around it.

How do I book?

Message us on LINE (@revivepilates) with your preferred day and time, and we'll confirm your trial slot.
